skills.name: Surprise Ram (金羊奇袭)
skills.line: Let's warm up before the curtain call.
skills.description: Kikinyou attacks a single target dealing damage equal to 100% of his ATK.

skills.name: Shadow Maneuver(宿影暗渡)
skills.line: There's always a surprise behind every trick.
skills.description: Exclusive effect. When the enemy loses 1 Average Onibi, Kikinyou gains 1 stack 宿影阵. ;Upon Usage :Kikinyou performs a sleight of hand, removes up to 2 Average Onibi from allies and returns an equal number of onibi back. ;? (宿影阵) : :'''Buff, Mark''': Max of 10 stacks. When the max is reached, all stacks are removed and immediately uses 宿影暗渡. ;Average Onibi (泛鬼火) :Any onibi on the onibi bar, includes Wish Power and Faux Orbs.

upgrades.text: '''Upper Hand''': Automatically gains 5 宿影阵 stacks at the start of battle.
'''Upon Usage''': Also removes 1 onibi from the enemy.
When 宿影阵 reaches its max limit, he gains Shelter.

skills.name: Ghost's Marvel: Constellation (鬼宿奇惊·长星)
skills.line: The puzzles in the world are always lethal.
skills.description: Exclusive effect. Kikinyou decreases all enemies HIT by 30%, lasts for 1 turn. Also has a 65% base chance to inflict Constellation Puzzle on a targeted enemy. ;Constellation Puzzle (长星锁) : :'''Debuff, Mark''': When the inflicted target reaches the bottom of the move bar, this effect us removed and 鬼宿奇惊·长星 is used to skip their turn. Kikinyou is immune to 长星锁.

upgrades.text: '''长星锁''': Also decreases the enemy's DEF by 100.
Upon usage, on the next non-summoned ally's, other than himself, turn they will consume 3 less onibi.
